dress.pattern.glittered_dots.description: Polka dots with integrated glitter weave
dress.pattern.glittered_dots.contents: Polka dots in accent color on glitter-woven fabric base. Dots and glitter unified in sparkle. Cheerful pattern with shimmer throughout.

dress.pattern.glittered_florals.description: Floral print with integrated glitter weave
dress.pattern.glittered_florals.contents: Small floral motifs in accent color woven throughout glitter-woven base fabric. Flowers catch light with shimmer. Sweet sparkling botanical.

dress.pattern.glitter_hearts.contents: GLITTER HEARTS in accent color stencil-printed in rows across dress. Each heart catches light with sparkle fill. Hearts shimmer and glint at every angle. Sweet romantic sparkle pattern.

dress.pattern.sequin_stars.contents: SEQUIN STARS in accent color in allover repeat across dress. Each star made of tiny sequins catching light. Stars twinkle and shimmer. Celestial sparkle magic.

dress.pattern.holographic_stripes.contents: HOLOGRAPHIC STRIPES across dress in DRESS COLOR. Each stripe shifts through lighter and darker tones with iridescent shimmer. Bands catch light with prismatic sparkle. Maximum holographic effect.

dress.pattern.crystal_butterflies.contents: CRYSTAL BUTTERFLIES stamped in repeat across dress. Each butterfly outlined in rhinestones catching light. Wings shimmer with iridescent sparkle. Magical flutter pattern.

dress.pattern.sparkle_bows.contents: GLITTER BOWS in accent color across dress. Each bow filled with sparkle catching light. Bows shimmer and glint. Sweet ribbon pattern with maximum shine.

dress.pattern.sequin_polka.contents: SEQUIN POLKA DOTS in accent color on dress. Each dot a cluster of sequins catching light. Dots shimmer and flash. Playful sparkle spots everywhere.

dress.pattern.glitter_flowers.contents: GLITTER FLOWERS in accent color printed allover dress. Petals filled with sparkle catching light from every angle. Sweet garden shimmer pattern.

dress.pattern.rhinestone_crowns.contents: RHINESTONE CROWNS in neat rows across dress. Each tiny crown outlined in crystals. Crowns catch light and sparkle. Princess motif with royal shimmer.

dress.pattern.iridescent_clouds.contents: IRIDESCENT CLOUDS printed in rows across dress in ACCENT COLOR. Cloud shapes shimmer with color-change effect. Dreamy iridescent sparkle. Sweet sky pattern.

dress.pattern.sequin_moons.contents: SEQUIN CRESCENT MOONS in accent color across dress. Each moon made of shimmering sequins. Moons catch light and twinkle. Celestial night sparkle.

dress.pattern.glitter_candy.contents: GLITTER CANDY shapes stencil-printed across dress. Lollipops and wrapped sweets in sparkle. Each candy catches light. Sweet treat shimmer pattern.

dress.pattern.crystal_snowflakes.contents: CRYSTAL SNOWFLAKES in repeat pattern across dress. Each snowflake made of rhinestones catching light. Snowflakes shimmer and sparkle. Winter princess magic.
